limitations: Whole-process local CPU is not platform CPU or exact per-function CPU
True uses fixture CA; public bundled-root/Meta workload differs
Baseline and prototype run in separate sequential processes; unrelated control batches also changed
One prototype true batch had 402 ms wall while using 190 ms process CPU; wall is not CPU
Earlier exploratory prototype true batches averaged 11 and 10.5 ms; no stable saving or Free compliance claim
Initial final regression launch named a nonexistent run.mjs; corrected node.mjs and workerd.mjs both passed separately
Only the intact logged comparison is included in batches; initial mixed-output log lost part of baseline and is not a full comparison
conclusion: Duplicate leaf parsing is real; no demonstrated stable CPU saving sufficient to address public gap. Candidate not promoted to production.
